notes.title: Updated with New content
notes.content:
This week I have added a new page of 28 Horns as well as some noses and new clothes and some bug fixes.
Grinding on..

notes.title: Update on the situation. Grinding on..
notes.content:
After a few slower months during the summer I am making good progress again.
The clothes section is still lacking and that is what I usually find the hardest to get inspired about, but I have been fleshing out some of it and will do more over the coming time.
I have aslo made other parts for instance new top hair and I added a new page for noses.

All in all I think the software is in a pretty good spot right now, and it gets better with every part added.

Thanks for all the suggestions and all the support! I appreciate it!

notes.title: Portrait Wizard going Scifi/Cyberpunk
notes.content:
Right now there is a good amount of Medieval Fantasy stuff in the software, so I am moving over to making Scifi/Cyberpunk stuff.

So far I have some weapons and some masks done, that can be combined with visors and other parts to create cyborg like characters.

notes.title: Update on Portrait Wizard
notes.content:
Okay, time for a little progress update.

Right now the software contains.

56 face base shapes
103 top hair
34 front hair(for both sides)
27 back hair(for both sides)
27 moustaches
27 beards
26 eye base shapes
27 eyelashes
26 Iris
26 highlights
24 makeup
24 eye glares
24 eyeshadow
27 eyebrows
54 noses
117 mouths.
2 male and 3 female body base shapes, and a few (10 plus) outfits for each type.
27 Shoulders for each side
26 Neck pieces
27 facial features and wrinkles
27 forehead wrinkles
27 scars
27 tattoos
27 ears
55 Backgrounds
25 Helmets
25 masks
26 visors
26 ornaments
26 horns
52 Weapons
26 scenes (scenes are overlays that add some mood or texture to the picture)
Lighting: Lighting is 16 adjustable flood lights that can be used for more advanced lighting and shading.

I also added simplified Chinese as an optional Language.

Thanks for the support so far and have a great day!

notes.title: A little update on the current state of Portrait Wizard.
notes.content:
Portrait Wizard is in a pretty good state right now, where you can create a lot of different kind of characters. Save and load your creations. And of course use the pixelation tool, if you like a more retro style portrait.

Some areas need more content, but most areas have a pretty good amount already.

The old storepage videos were replaced by a newer version, that I quickly put together yesterday.
I removed the tutorial as well, as it was so outdated.
The new version is also a temporary video until it again gets greatly outdated or the software is finished. 
But for now it can showcase how this software works.

Looking forward, there is still more content that I will create, 
and then there is the Workshop, which I want to implement, so that people can share content with each other.

Anyway, thanks for the support and I hope you all have a great summer!

notes.title: Current state of Portrait Wizard.
notes.content:
Since Portrait Wizard was released in Early access 85 days ago, there has been 54 minor updates, with new content.

The most important feature(imo) was added a couple of days ago, with the new Save/Load feature, that lets you save a portrait, as both a BMP and an INI file, so that you can load it up and work on it later.

There are still areas that need a lot of work, so for people who are interested, but want a complete product, this is not the time to get it. 
However, if you want to have a chance to influence the content added, or want to get started making some portraits, this could be a good time to get into Portrait Wizard.

When I first released Portrait Wizard in Early Access, I aimed for a first quarter full release, but it will take longer, since I want to make sure there is enough content, and that all the content is of good quality. 

For more information on the updates, you can check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/685300/discussions/0/3183345000083014938/] "Update log" [/url] .
For suggestions you can visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/685300/discussions/0/1621724915773342012/] "Wishlist/suggestions thread" [/url] .

Thanks to everyone who have supported Portrait Wizard so far!

notes.title: New Tutorial video up on the store page.
notes.content:
A new video is up, that explains how Portrait wizard works, 
and it takes you through the process of creating portraits.

The length is a good 20 minutes, and it explains most of the features of the software, and a little of what is planned for the near future.

Of course the video will be a bit outdated in a few days, since I add stuff and update pretty often, but it gives a good idea of what to expect, and it shows you how you interact with the software, to create your own unique custom character portraits.

notes.title: Pixelation Tool
notes.content:
A simple pixelation tool has been added to the Early Access release.
It has 5 presets, where 1 is the least and 5 is the most pixelated.

For those who did not follow the Greenlight campaign, the software also comes with a simple resizing and cutting tool.
